events.label: Brookings assessment of U.S.-China strategic competition

slots.name: conflict duration
slots.sentence: Today, it is the U.S. military that is more bloodied and depleted after a quarter century of nearly continuous conflict.

slots.name: China conflict-free period
slots.sentence: China, meanwhile, is a manufacturing powerhouse that has avoided military conflict for more than four decades.

slots.name: strategy count
slots.sentence: The previous two U.S. National Defense Strategies identified China as the U.S. “pacing challenge.”

slots.name: Middle East war duration
slots.sentence: After 25 years of war in the Middle East, U.S. military preeminence in the Indo-Pacific is receding.

slots.name: National Defense Strategy publication date
slots.sentence: The most recent National Defense Strategy, published in 2026, does not even designate China a pacing challenge.
